d:
Nitish Kumar ko RJD ka CM vala ophar, kya milkar bhi bana paenge sarkar ?
Bihar ki rajniti men aarjedi aur jediyu ke bich sanbhavit gathbandhan ko lekar ek bar phir charchaen tej ho gaee hain. charchaon ka bajar garm huaa hai aarjedi sansad abhay kushvaha ke ek bayan se.... vo bayan jismen unhonne nitish kumar ko aarjedi ke sath phir aane ka nyota diya...aur badle men nishant ko siem banane ka prastav....samjhie aankre
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
Welcome to Bihar Tak
